proves.claim: with items.barRulesAtAdd on, add and edit refuse CROSS_OWNERSHIP when the coordinator files a lane item whose Files list names a path no lane owns, and --split-coordinator still files both pieces.

cli.io-item-bar-owners.coordinator-filer.why: Without it the coordinator's add returned early and a bar nobody could build was filed, then refused at claim.

proves.claim: with the setting on, a lane item whose criterion names an unowned path while its Files list names only its lane's paths is filed with no refusal.

cli.io-item-bar-owners.read-only-paths-f.why: Without it every cells or contract bar that cites a file it only reads is refused at add.

proves.claim: with the setting off, add accepts the coordinator's bar as today and a coordinator-lane item may name any path.

cli.io-item-bar-owners.setting-off-uncha.why: Without it turning the rule on by default would change every board that has not opted in.
